svg.aria-label: Maanav Krishna builds systems that hold up when no one is watching. CSE at SRMIST, class of 2029, Chennai. Now shipping: Aftershock (live), PyWeb (on PyPI), Hum (1st place), Cadabra (Fire TV), Deadlock (v0.3.0), Countersign (live). Open to internships.
